About

I specialize in Systems Analysis with over 20 years of experience in software development, system analysis, platform integration and problem solving.

My expertise includes observability and support skills, AWS, REST/SOAP APIs, Salesforce and System Development (Java, Node.js, Python, Go and .NET).

I am proud to lead teams and deliver robust technological solutions, prioritizing operational efficiency, innovation and measurable results. SRE certified, with expertise in Data Science, Business Agility and AWS, I combine technical knowledge and strategic vision to manage complex projects.

In addition, I stress the creation of collaborative environments and the positive impact on teams and organizations. I love challenges where I can combine technical expertise, business vision and agile practices to achieve transformative results.

Evolution of Accreditation in the Standard Plan
Optimization of the logistic operation, managing to perform in D0 in most cases the complete delivery of the proposal made by the commercial. SalesforceIpricing
Situation

The accreditation in the standard plane was treated in a different flow of screens with specific information, integrations and filling. The main needs of the commercial area were opened in three major epics: Sending more than one machine in the Standard Plan Accreditation, Sending more than one technology in the Standard Plan Accreditation, Validation of Flex hiring eligibility in the Standard Plan Accreditation.

Tasks
  • Implement in the flow of the standard plane the filling of the amount of machines per type of technology.
  • Implement the same eligibility consultation of Ipricing Flex contracting.
  • To homologate all integrations to the generation of Service Orders and PV.
Actions
  • Refined needs and elaborated a short delivery strategy of simple implementation and in parallel the discovery of total absorption of the flow of the standard plan within the trading process of Ipricing 2.0.
  • The possibility was initially given only to inform more than one machine for a single technology.
  • It was delivered following the unified journey of Ipricing 2.0 considering as the standard offer options, with or without Flex depending on eligibility and also with the possibility to choose more than one type of technology and also inform more than one machine per technology in the proposal.
Results
  • Optimization of the logistic operation, managing to perform in D0 in most cases the complete delivery of the proposal made by the commercial.
  • Optimization of the Executive operational that does not need to open new machine requests after the proposal.
  • Executive informs the customer correctly in hiring time if it has the anticipation in D2.
  • Agility in the delivery of demands, being the three great epics solved in two strategic deliveries.
  • Standardization of the negotiation day without further the need for two squads to take care of Cockpit Accreditation.
